capture_source: live capture 2026-08-26 at the transport seam; SAP A4H kernel 793 release 758, sysnr 00, unicode, codepage 4103. Sanitised preserving byte length: the 8-ASCII-digit GW conversation handle at [40:48], and the 16-byte 0x0514 session token where present. No NI length prefix - captured above the NI layer.
evidence: paired response to rfc_read_table_delta_request.bin; return code 0x0420 == 0
notes: Shows BOTH ways a table comes back. DATA and OPTIONS - tables the client did not send - arrive under 0x0301 carrying their names, with server-assigned 0x0330 ids (6 and 7 here).

FIELDS - the table the client DID send - arrives under 0x0335 instead, identified by the DM table ID the client assigned it, not by name. The 0x0335 value is 12 bytes: three BE uint32 [opcode=10, dm_table_id=1, row_count=4]. It is followed by the usual 0x0302 info record and one 0x0304 per row, terminated by 0x0336 (4 bytes).
Confirmed by varying the row count against a fixed DM id: sending 2 rows yields 0x0335 = [10, 1, 2]; sending 4 rows (this capture) yields [10, 1, 4].
A reader that recognises only 0x0301 drops such parameters from the result entirely - which surfaces to callers as a missing key rather than an error.
Tag 0x0331 (4 bytes, value 1) precedes the parameter section in delta-bearing responses. Purpose [ASSUMED] - not needed to parse the tables.
